items.title: M1 contract audit and failing reproduction for JSON stdout
items.context: 确认 --json / --format=json stdout contract，复现 validate --json 追加 hint 破坏 JSON.parse，并列出受影响/未受影响命令矩阵。
items.userSees: 开发计划明确说明 dashboard 可以直接 JSON.parse Lattice CLI stdout，不需要 substring parser。

happy.desc: validate --json 当前失败被真实 CLI 子进程复现，错误定位到 hint decoration

edge.desc: 已有正常 --format=json 命令仍被纳入矩阵，避免误判全 CLI 都坏

adversarial.desc: 禁止把修复方案定为 dashboard 侧抽取 JSON substring

verificationEvidence.command: Agent 1 read-only reproduction: validate --json stdout followed by direct JSON.parse before fix
verificationEvidence.note: Agent 1 reproduced the original pre-fix failure: validate --json returned JSON plus a human success hint, so direct JSON.parse(stdout) failed; the root cause was hint decoration after the validate handler returned JSON text.

verificationEvidence.command: Agent 1 JSON command matrix for validate, authority_status, host_runtime_probe, and parallel_status
verificationEvidence.note: Agent 1 documented the affected/unaffected matrix: validate --json was broken because validate is hint-decorated, while representative existing JSON commands remained parseable because they were not in the hint registry.

verificationEvidence.command: Review Agent 1 recommendation plus commit 8a0c0705 implementation approach
verificationEvidence.note: The selected fix explicitly rejects dashboard-side substring extraction and places the guard in the shared CLI output pipeline; Agent 3 confirmed no extractFirstJsonObject/regex JSON substring parser was introduced.

items.title: M2 fix CLI output pipeline to suppress stdout hints in machine JSON mode
items.context: 在 cli-engine 统一判断 args.json===true 或 format=json；JSON mode 不调用/不输出 hint decoration，text mode 保留现有人类 next-step hint。
items.userSees: lattice validate --json stdout 只剩 JSON；lattice validate text mode 仍有人类下一步提示。

happy.desc: validate --json stdout 可直接 JSON.parse 且没有 “→ 验证全绿”

edge.desc: text mode validate 仍保留 “→ 验证全绿” next-step hint

adversarial.desc: 失败/coverage missing 的 JSON mode 也不能把修复建议拼进 stdout

verificationEvidence.command: KOALA_SESSION_ID=codex-b7fc2 node packages/main/dist/cli.js validate --story=B-7fc2 --json --forceTakeover | node -e JSON.parse(stdin)
verificationEvidence.note: Worktree dist validate --json stdout parsed directly as a single JSON document; no human success hint was appended to stdout in machine JSON mode.
Text-mode validate still emitted the human success next-step hint containing 验证全绿; the text-mode UX was preserved while JSON mode was cleaned.

verificationEvidence.command: KOALA_SESSION_ID=codex-b7fc2 node packages/main/dist/cli.js validate --story=B-7fc2 --json --forceTakeover | node -e JSON.parse(stdin)
verificationEvidence.note: Even when validate returned allPass=false because verification evidence was missing, worktree JSON mode stdout remained direct-parseable; the failure guidance was not appended to stdout.

items.title: M3 add regression smoke and document the JSON stdout contract
items.context: 新增 CLI JSON stdout contract smoke，覆盖 validate --json、至少一个 --format=json 命令、text mode hint 保留；文档写明 stdout machine-only，human guidance 只在 text mode 或 stderr。
items.userSees: 后续 dashboard/read-only adapter 可以把 Lattice CLI JSON stdout 当稳定 contract。

happy.desc: 新 smoke 直接 JSON.parse execFileSync stdout

edge.desc: 一个已经正常的 --format=json 命令继续 parseable，防止输出管线回归

adversarial.desc: 测试断言 stdout 不含 next-step hint，避免未来误把 hint 加回 JSON mode

verificationEvidence.note: The new smoke spawns real CLI child processes and feeds captured stdout directly into JSON.parse, covering validate --json without substring extraction.
The smoke also covers existing --format=json surfaces such as authority_status and host_list, proving known-good JSON commands remain direct-parseable through the shared output pipeline.
The smoke asserts JSON stdout contains no human hint markers and that trimmed validate --json output ends at the single JSON document boundary, preventing future trailing decoration regressions.

items.title: M4 run three-agent Claude Code review, delivery evidence, and DONE gates
items.context: Agent1 做 contract/test audit，Agent2 做实现，Agent3 做独立 review/delivery；Codex 复核后跑 Lattice validate、用户验收 transcript、summary/delivery_check_set/DONE。
items.userSees: story DONE 后有 Claude Code 三 agent 证据、Codex 审核结论和真实 CLI acceptance transcript。

happy.desc: Claude Code 三个 agent 均产出可追踪结论，Lattice delivery-check 接收

edge.desc: 如果某 agent 发现 blocking issue，story 留在 DEV/REVIEW 修复而不是硬 DONE

adversarial.desc: DONE summary 必须明确 no limitations 或列出未覆盖 JSON 命令，不允许抽象说全绿

verificationEvidence.command: Claude Code Agent 1 audit + Agent 2 implementation + Agent 3 independent review; Codex reran focused validation
verificationEvidence.note: All three Claude Code roles produced traceable conclusions: Agent 1 audit, Agent 2 implementation commit 8a0c0705, and Agent 3 pass review; Codex reran build, focused smoke, migration smoke, direct JSON.parse, and text hint checks.

verificationEvidence.command: Agent 3 independent review and lattice finding_list --storyId=B-7fc2
verificationEvidence.note: Agent 3 found no blockers or advisory regressions, and finding_list returned no findings; if blockers had been found, the story would have remained in DEV rather than being advanced.

Delivery evidence states the scoped limitation explicitly: no known limitations for the JSON stdout contract, while resolver/dashboard schema completion remains outside B-7fc2 and belongs to the host-neutral observability milestones.
